name: Reference picture
purpose: Let people in at the start. The photo, the sketch, the thing that caught your eye. By the time the painting is finished they feel they were there.
shots: The reference photo or sketchbook page
Reference next to the blank or just-started canvas
caption: What caught you about this. One or two sentences. Not what it is, what it is about.
cta: Ask a question people can answer with one word.

name: Work in progress
purpose: The most reliable post there is. People love watching a thing get made. With a painting every 3 days, there is always one on the easel.
shots: Canvas on the easel, phone photo, natural light
Detail crop of the part you worked on today
Palette and brushes next to the canvas
caption: Where it is at today. One sentence on what is working or what is fighting you.
cta: Ask whether to push it further or stop.

name: Painting video
purpose: Reach. Video of the painting being made, or a slow pan over the finished surface, is how strangers find the work. Record once, post to four platforms.
shots: Phone on a tripod, 9:16, over the shoulder or straight on
10-20 min of real painting cut to the best 20-45s
Or: slow pan across the finished painting, ending on a pull-back of the whole thing
caption: On-screen text or voiceover: what you were thinking during this part. Keep it human.
cta: Follow to see it finished / link to buy.

name: Talking to camera
purpose: This is what builds a fan base. People buy from a person they feel they know. One idea per video: why this painting, what you learned, an answer to a comment.
shots: Phone at eye level, window light, the painting behind you
30-90s for Shorts/TikTok, or 2-6 min for YouTube
Start mid-thought, no intro
caption: The one idea, as the title. Example: 'Why I painted this twice'.
cta: Ask them to tell you which painting they would hang.

name: Studio shot
purpose: People follow a person, not a catalog. The studio, the wall of work, the mess, the mistakes.
shots: Wide shot of the studio
Work leaning against the wall
Hands, brushes, palette, the floor
caption: Something true about being a painter today. Short.

name: Slice of life
purpose: Outside the studio. The walk, the coffee, the light, what you are reading. Keeps the account human between paintings.
shots: Whatever is true today, one photo
caption: One line. No explanation needed.

name: Finished work
purpose: The payoff post. Shoot it properly. This image gets reused for the for-sale post, the prints, the newsletter, the video.
shots: Straight on, even daylight, no glare, cropped to the edges
One shot in a room or leaning on a wall for scale
One tight detail
caption: Title, size, medium. One line about what it ended up being about. Whether it is available.
cta: DM to collect / link in bio / prints coming.

name: The story behind it
purpose: The why. This is the post that turns a liker into a buyer. Text does the work, the image just needs to be there.
shots: The finished piece, or a detail of it
caption: Where the idea came from, what happened while making it, what it means now. 3-6 sentences. Honest beats clever.
cta: If this one speaks to you, it is available. Link.

name: Work for sale
purpose: Say it is for sale, plainly, with a price. Most people never buy because they were never asked. Every listed painting gets this post, more than once.
shots: The piece in a room for scale
The piece straight on
caption: Title, size, price, shipping, how to buy. One line about it. That is all.
cta: DM me / link in bio. Say which.

name: Prints announcement
purpose: Most people cannot buy the original. Prints turn the audience into customers at a price that works for them. Sold originals are the best print candidates.
shots: The print in a frame on a real wall
Hands holding the print
Close-up of the paper texture
caption: Prints of [title] are up. Sizes. Paper. How many, if limited.

name: Drop teaser
purpose: A week out. Name the date. Show a crop, not the whole thing.
shots: A detail crop, or the piece turned to the wall
caption: Something new is coming [day]. One line about it.
cta: Subscribe on Substack to see it first.

name: Drop reminder
purpose: The day before. Substack goes first, socials after. Show the whole piece now.
shots: The finished piece
caption: Tomorrow at [time]. What it is, what it costs, how many.
cta: Set a reminder / reply to claim early.

name: Drop is live
purpose: Drop day. Post everywhere within the same hour. Stay online and reply.
shots: The piece
The piece in a room
A short video of you with it
caption: It is live. Title, price, link. Keep it short, the link is the point.

name: Last call
purpose: Two days after. Most sales come from the reminder, not the announcement.
shots: The piece, or what is left
caption: Still available / X left. Thank the people who bought.

name: Sold / collector
purpose: Social proof. Every sale is a post. The packed box, the piece on the collector's wall, the thank you.
shots: The packed order with the label
Collector's photo of it hung (ask for one)
The empty spot on the studio wall
caption: This one went to [city]. Thank you. One line about what it meant.
cta: Mention what is still available, lightly.

name: Reply block
purpose: Reach on Threads is made in the replies. 15 minutes, twice a day, right after your posts.
caption: Reply to every comment on today's posts. Then leave 10 real comments on other painters' and collectors' posts. No emoji-only replies.

name: Repost a winner
purpose: Your best posts were seen by a fraction of your audience. Run them again with a new first line.
shots: Same image as the original
caption: Rewrite the first line. Keep the rest.

name: Newsletter
purpose: Weekly. The people on the list are the people who buy. Two paintings finished this week, so there is always something to show.
shots: The best images from the week: this week's finished pieces, one WIP
caption: What got made, what is for sale, what is coming, one story. Under 300 words.
cta: One link to what is for sale.

name: Photograph finished work
purpose: One good photo of each finished piece unlocks the reveal, the for-sale post, the prints, the newsletter, the video. Do it within 3 days of finishing.
shots: Daylight, straight on, no glare, tripod
In a room for scale
Three details
A 20s slow pan video while you are at it

name: Create listing
purpose: Finished work that is not for sale anywhere is not for sale. List it, then move it to 'listed' so the for-sale posts start.
shots: Use the photo session images
caption: Title, size, medium, year, price, shipping, the story paragraph.

name: Film talking videos
purpose: Batch it. Film 3 talking-to-camera videos in one sitting, one per painting from this week. Then the week's video slots are just uploads.
shots: Phone at eye level, window light, one painting behind you per video
One idea each, 30-90s, start mid-thought

name: Weekly review and plan
purpose: Look at what performed this week. Move works through the pipeline. Set next week's drop dates. Then stop thinking about it until next Sunday.
caption: Open the Pipeline tab. Update each work's stage and dates. Check each painting's coverage row for gaps. Note the top 3 posts of the week and why.

name: Batch captions
purpose: Write next week's Threads posts in one sitting so posting days are just copy and paste.
caption: Draft 12 posts in the Notes app. Mix: 4 WIP, 2 studio, 2 story, 2 for-sale, 1 reference, 1 repost.
